scripts.dev:full: (pnpm install && pnpm db && pnpm orm && pnpm dev)
scripts.dev:full:no-migration: pnpm install && pnpm dev && pnpm orm:push && pnpm dev
scripts.db: (docker compose up -d db && docker compose ps) || (cd .. && docker-compose up -d db && docker-compose ps && cd src)
scripts.orm: (pnpm contract:emit && pnpm exec prisma db migrate --yes) || echo 'If no migrations yet, try orm:push'
scripts.orm:push: pnpm contract:emit && pnpm exec prisma db update
scripts.orm:update: pnpm contract:emit && pnpm exec prisma migration plan --name
